title: Experiment 2 integrity check vs historical resume defect

historical_room213.interpretation: A. Historical Room failure is broken resume / under-training, not a densify-policy result.

distinction.A_historical_room_failure: Broken resume / under-training. Historical Room 213 Gaussian tensors froze at step 2250. Not a converged 30k-step model.
distinction.B_controlled_densify_effect: This run. Arm A refine_stop_iter=500 stayed at seed 209587. Arm B refine_stop_iter=4300 grew to 7499239. Checkpoint gauss_params SHA256 changed at every save on both arms.

1_start_from_step_0_no_resume.evidence: Both ns-train.log: No Nerfstudio checkpoint to load, so training from scratch. train-cmd has no --load-dir. loaded_absolute_step=0.

2_optimizer_bound_to_live_params_after_i.evidence: From-scratch path plus every 750-step checkpoint has a different gauss_params SHA256 for means/scales/quats/opacities/features. Historical orphaning would have frozen those hashes.

3_parameters_change_between_ckpts.arm_b: count and hashes both change through stop_split_at=4300; after 4500 count frozen at 7499239 but hashes still change through 7999

6_gsplat_1_5_3.evidence: gsplat-cuda.json both arms: version 1.5.3, cuda_ops true. torch 2.5.1+cu124. No 'CUDA toolkit found' disable line in ns-train.log.
